zh: 新增 @welink-slash-command 技能：支持管理、生成、注册与调试 WeLink 客户端斜杠命令（基于 assistant-command-executor）。
频道对接 WeLink 新增可视化斜杠命令管理卡片：支持在网页端配置、发布与下架命令，并可一键导出 Python 脚手架代码。
优化 WeLink 扫码与斜杠命令表格垂直居中对齐排版，增强内网升级环境校验提示。
en: Added @welink-slash-command skill to manage, scaffold, register and debug WeLink client slash commands with assistant-command-executor.
Added visual slash commands management card under WeLink channel settings to publish, manage and export Python scaffolds directly.
Refined vertical alignment for slash commands tables and enhanced intranet environment checks for CLI upgrades.
